sentences.text: 2 . PR OS ECUTR IX THROUGH POLICE STATION  RAWATPURA, BHIND (MADHYA PRADESH)

(BY SHRI RAJIV UPADHYAY - PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER
Instant petition has been filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.

At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner informed this Court that purpose of filing of this petition is over because trial from which this petition emanates itself has been decided and acquittal has been recorded in favour of the petitioner for alleged offences under Sections363, 366, 376 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act by the Sessions Court, Lahar, District Bhind.
Therefore, this petition has become rendered infructuous.
